body:
3 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

The stories:

Charlie Tasker thriving during loan spell at Rochdale from Brighton (Rochdale). Charlie Tasker, on loan from Brighton, is making a strong impact at Rochdale, adapting well to a new position and earning the fans' support.

Road closures announced for Heywood Christmas Festival on 14 November 2026 (Heywood). Temporary road closures will affect several streets in Heywood during the Christmas Festival, as announced by Rochdale Borough Council.

Heywood’s Little Play Town put up for sale as owner reassures families it will stay open (Heywood). Owner Jackie is seeking a buyer after four years, with Little Play Town remaining open and existing party bookings going ahead as planned.

Weather: Cloudy 12°C in Rochdale today.
